envelope.description: Verification: invariants, site list, no floating promises, old paths, migration rows

body.title: Verification: invariants, site list, no floating promises, old paths, migration rows
body.summary: Check the invariants that rest on the epic constraints against the code (a schema failure is never passed on; the client reaches the daemon only through IPC; a destructive call with no client is denied; provider-reaching code awaits serially), then add the site-list test (31 gh wrappers equal the github.ts exports, the client scan finds two sites, one named exemption and five no-site files), the compiler-API no-floating-promises scan, the old-paths-unchanged test (runGit, runGitAsync, runGh, commitAndPushArtifacts, the wrappers, createGitRunner and _setTrackerExecForTests still exported; the scan in report mode), and write the migration record rows.
acceptanceChecks: the site list is complete and every site has a table row and a registry test
no unawaited TrackerPort, IssueOps, CloseIssue or loader call remains
the old paths are still exported unchanged and the scan is in report mode
each invariant resting on k2 to k5 has a named check that passes

tests.name: site-list.test.ts: the 31 gh wrapper names in the table equal the github.ts gh exports; every site has a table row and a registry test; the migration record lists the rows
cli-services-sites.test.ts: the scan of src/cli/services finds two sites, one named exemption and five no-site files
no-floating-promises.test.ts: the compiler-API scan finds no unawaited TrackerPort, IssueOps, CloseIssue or loader call
old-paths-unchanged.test.ts: the old paths are still exported unchanged and the scan stays in report mode
